review.en: Black Sabbath's second album, released in 1970, set down much of heavy metal's vocabulary: Tony Iommi's slow, heavy riffs, a rhythm section that swings, and lyrics about war, madness and dread. War Pigs, Iron Man and the quickly written title track became foundations of the genre, while Planet Caravan shows a quieter side.
review.zh: 黑色安息日 1970 年的第二张专辑，奠定了重金属的大半语汇：托尼·艾奥米缓慢沉重的连复段、带摇摆感的节奏组，以及关于战争、疯狂与恐惧的歌词。《War Pigs》《Iron Man》和匆匆写成的同名曲成了这一类型的基石，《Planet Caravan》则露出安静的一面。
